title: Udaan – Interact Students Win Art Competition

photo.alt: Interact students proudly showcase their award-winning trophy at Udaan, celebrating their success in the District-level Freedom of Expression art competition. Their achievement reflects the creativity, confidence and talent of young learners.

summary: On 9 October 2026, students from the Rotary Club of Deonar's two Interact schools, Vivekananda English High School and General Education Academy, participated in Udaan, the District Conference for Interactors.
description:
On 9 October 2026, students from the Rotary Club of Deonar's two Interact schools, Vivekananda English High School and General Education Academy, participated in Udaan, the District Conference for Interactors. The students showcased their creativity and artistic abilities in the Freedom of Expression art competition, using art as a medium to communicate ideas, perspectives and individual expression.

Both schools were recognised as winners and brought home trophies for their outstanding artwork. This achievement provided the students with an opportunity to demonstrate their talent, build confidence, interact with students from other schools and experience the value of healthy competition. The recognition celebrated their creativity, encouraged self-expression and motivated young students to explore their potential beyond the classroom.

gallery.alt: Interact students proudly showcase their award-winning trophy at Udaan, celebrating their success in the District-level Freedom of Expression art competition. Their achievement reflects the creativity, confidence and talent of young learners.

Students from the participating schools receive recognition for their outstanding artwork at Udaan. The award celebrates their artistic expression, imagination and ability to communicate ideas through creativity.

Interact students celebrate their achievement together, proudly displaying their trophies and certificates. The recognition encourages teamwork, confidence and greater participation in creative and cultural activities.
Students from Vivekananda English High School celebrate their success at the District Interact Conference, showcasing the talent and creative potential nurtured through the Interact programme.
The winning Interact student celebrates her achievement alongside the Club President and school representative, marking a proud moment of recognition and encouragement for young talent.

location: Deenanath Mangeshkar Hall, Auditorium, Vile Parle (East), Mumbai, Maharashtra
